validatorPolicy.note: Three validators can continue with one unavailable validator, but do not tolerate one Byzantine validator. Plan a controlled QBFT validator-set update before expanding the set.

earlyUserRewards.distribution: The full allocation is credited to this address at genesis; the allocation owner manages later distribution.

validatorRewards.distribution: The full reserve is credited to this address at genesis. Transaction gas fees are paid to the QBFT block proposer, not automatically to this reserve; genesis block rewards remain zero.
